derives_from: docs/fable5-app-integration-readiness/contracts/guardrail_pipeline_contract.json (C8, C9) and mock-harness guardrail_gauntlet_scenarios (GG-01..GG-12); extends app/src/lib/scope-guard.ts pattern classes without modifying that file

pre_retrieval.check: excluded statutory titles 39/40/55 with statutory context
general legal knowledge requests outside the closed universe
ruling requests: asks the system to decide the case
credibility determinations about parties or witnesses
extra-record fact requests about named individuals
prompt injection markers in query or conversation window
juvenile-context override rules borrowed from scope-guard JUVENILE_CONTEXT_PATTERN, extended per doc 07

post_retrieval.check: answer_scope mix validation: guardrail_reference_only rows cannot ground a general answer
as-of-date window sanity vs effectivity metadata

post_generation.check: every citation in the draft resolves through citation-verifier.ts against adapter envelopes
no uncited authority claims (sentence-level support scan)
scope leakage scan: excluded titles/topics reintroduced by the model
refusal-conversion: any GA failure converts the response to unsupported_answer refusal, never a degraded answer

fail_closed_rules: pattern file load failure disables answering entirely (error envelope), not guardrails (GG-11)
multi-turn window is re-screened every turn; a passing turn cannot whitelist a later tripping turn (GG-09, GG-10)

pattern_data_design.contains: regex source strings + class labels + refusal_kind mapping; no legal body text; SYNTHETIC test triggers namespaced under synthetic_triggers
pattern_data_design.loading: parsed once at module init with schema guard; compiled patterns cached

outputs.audit: every refuse verdict produces a refusal record write before the envelope is emitted
